en.headline: Police seize 20kg of ketamine from transitional housing unit in Lau Fau Shan
en.dek: Officers raided a unit in Yuen Long and arrested a 31-year-old man; the drugs and packaging tools were valued at about HK$8 million.
body: Police seized about 20 kilograms of suspected ketamine and packaging tools from a transitional housing unit in Lau Fau Shan on Saturday and arrested a 31-year-old local man.

The Narcotics Bureau said officers raided a unit on Sham Wan Road that the man had been using as a storage facility. They found 49 packs weighing roughly 20 kg of the drug, commonly known as K, along with scales, bags and other tools. The haul was valued at about HK$8 million.

The unemployed man was charged with trafficking in a dangerous drug. He is due to appear at Tuen Mun Magistrates' Courts on Monday. Police said he had been induced by money to use the government-subsidised unit for the activity, and stressed that transitional housing is intended for people with urgent housing needs.

zh.headline: 流浮山過渡性房屋單位作毒品倉 警檢800萬氯胺酮拘一男
zh.dek: 警方在元朗流浮山深灣路一個過渡性房屋單位檢獲約20公斤氯胺酮，拘捕31歲本地男子，市值約800萬元。
body: 警方周六在流浮山展開反毒品行動，突擊搜查一個過渡性房屋單位，檢獲約20公斤懷疑氯胺酮及大量包裝工具。
毒品調查科指，人員在深灣路單位內發現49包共重約20公斤氯胺酮，以及電子磅等分裝工具，市值約800萬港元。現場拘捕一名31歲姓廖、無業的本地男子。
被捕人已被暫控一項「販運危險藥物」罪，案件將於周一在屯門裁判法院提堂。警方表示，他受金錢利誘利用自己租住的過渡性房屋單位作為毒品儲存倉，並強調過渡性房屋是為有迫切住屋需要的市民而設。
